text:
oliver_ae: Quick thread to align on LumenHealth POC scope before tomorrow's kickoff. Goals: 3-week trial, clinical note summarization + retrieval, live streaming for clinician UI. Needables: auth model, quota uplift, data residency concerns, cost estimate. cc @tara_se @nina_security

tara_se: A few immediate Qs: 1) Do they need real-time per-token streaming or batched paragraph updates? 2) Are embeddings required for retrieval tasks during POC? 3) Concurrency target (simultaneous clinicians)?

mike_cs: From CS: expected concurrent users ~5 clinicians, spike to 12. They'll run ~500 eval prompts/week, want automated eval harness + dashboard. Success criteria: precision on key-finding >= 0.85 and end-user acceptance demo w/ clinician.

tara_se: Implementation notes: streaming supports SSE or WS. If they want token-level alignment back to source, we can include token_offset metadata and source_span id. SDK examples will show structured_output with token.metadata.start/end.

nina_security: Security: they asked about PHI handling and where logs live. Hosted product is not BAA-covered by default; for PHI we require BAA and recommend Dedicated or Private. We support customer KMS in Dedicated; hosted can enable key-wrapping under contract. Audit logs retention configurable for enterprise. Share redacted questionnaire now.

devon_infra: Quota defaults for trials: 3 RPS and 150k tokens/day. For a POC we can uplift to 25 RPS and 2M tokens/day for up to 30 days after procurement approval. Uplift timeline: ~24 hours after signed trial sheet. Need IP allowlist and egress CIDRs.

kevin_prod: SDK / retries guidance: use idempotency-key for non-streaming calls. For streaming, client emits resume_token in headers; implement exponential backoff + resume logic. Example snippet (JS): on('data', d => saveOffset(d.token.metadata.start))

oliver_ae: Pricing question from Lumen: what is the estimated cost for 2M tokens/month + embeddings used for retrieval (approx 100k embeddings)? Can we provide a capped trial credit estimate?

devon_infra: Rough trial credit: account for generation = $0.0006/token-equivalent for clinical model (example), embeddings unit costs separate. For a POC we normally provide a $5k trial credit and reassess. I'll confirm exact numbers with finance.

nina_security: Quick checklist items delivered: abridged security questionnaire, inbound data flow diagram request, BAA next steps (if PHI). If they pseudonymize before transit, hosted may be acceptable for short-term pilot but we must document residual risk.

lumen_it: Lumen IT: we will pseudonymize client-side and can provide a sandbox S3 with de-identified notes. We also need streaming callbacks to include our note_id and text_offsets so clinicians can click into source. Is that possible?

tara_se: Yes  include note_id in structured_output.metadata.source_id and offsets in structured_output.tokens[].metadata.offsets. We can also emit a mapping file post-process if preferred.

mike_cs: For the eval harness: we'll run 1k golden prompts, collect ROUGE + clinician-rated correctness. Can dev provide a small python harness that posts to streaming endpoint and saves final summary + token offsets?

tara_se: I'll drop a lightweight python and node harness (stream + non-stream) into the shared drive after this thread. It will include guidance for short-lived API keys and scopes.

oliver_ae: Action items summary:
- @tara_se: SDK snippets + eval harness link by EOD
- @devon_infra: formal quota uplift form & trial credit estimate
- @nina_security: completed abridged questionnaire + note on BAA triggers
- @mike_cs: confirm eval goldset and acceptance metrics with Lumen prior to sync
- @lumen_it: share de-identified samples and IP allowlist

lumen_it: We uploaded a 500-note sample to the sandbox S3 and added your service IPs to the allowlist. We'll share the S3 path in the call. Also request: can logs include per-request request_id and user_id for audit?

devon_infra: Yes - request_id and user_id are included in request logs. For Hosted we redact PII from logs by default; for Dedicated we can keep raw logs behind customer VPC.

nina_security: Noted. If they want raw PHI logs retained we need Dedicated + BAA. We'll scope possible mitigations for pseudonymized hosted pilot.

mike_cs: Scheduling the 30m kickoff now for tomorrow 9:30am PT. Thanks all.

tara_se: Posting SDK snippets now in the shared folder. Will link here once live.

oliver_ae: Thanks team thumbsup. We'll finalize acceptance criteria before the kickoff and have infra/security approvals as required.
